DoubtBackup.title: DoubtBackup
DoubtBackup.description: Cloud-synced doubt item backed up and synchronized across devices for a user.

localId.description: Original Room database row ID on the originating client device.

cloudId.description: Collision-free cross-device identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

sessionCloudId.description: Cross-device cloudId of the parent ConversationSession this doubt belongs to.

query.description: The spoken or typed doubt question.

summary.description: Resolved AI detailed answer or explanation.

oneSentenceSummary.description: Optional single-sentence summary for quick list scanning.

customTag.description: Comma-separated custom labels such as Work, Study, or Personal.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the doubt was recorded locally.

isResolved.description: Whether the doubt has been resolved.

isStarred.description: Whether the user pinned or favorited this doubt.

isAmbiguous.description: Whether the doubt triggered interactive clarification.

suggestedOptionsJson.description: JSON array of suggested clarification options.

isFactChecked.description: Whether grounded external verification sources are attached.

verificationSourcesJson.description: JSON array of verified external URLs and excerpts.

updatedAtMillis.description: Client mutation epoch milliseconds used for cross-device merge conflict resolution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

SessionBackup.title: SessionBackup
SessionBackup.description: Cloud-synced chat and conversation session synchronized across devices for a user.

localId.description: Original Room session row ID on the originating device.

cloudId.description: Collision-free cross-device identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the session ended/saved.

startTime.description: Epoch milliseconds when the session started.

endTime.description: Epoch milliseconds when the session ended.

averageDoubtIntensity.description: Average doubt intensity across the session (0.0 to 1.0).

peakDoubtIntensity.description: Peak doubt intensity observed in the session (0.0 to 1.0).

doubtCount.description: Number of doubts detected in this session.

updatedAtMillis.description: Client mutation epoch milliseconds used for cross-device merge conflict resolution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

/users/{userId}/doubts/{doubtId}.description: Per-user synced DoubtItem records isolated by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Per-user synced ConversationSession records isolated by Firebase Auth UID.
